notes: Adds a narrow Vault Intake Import workflow beside Vault Records. It accepts only local tee-vault-intake-v1 JSON files, previews public-safe record summaries while hiding protected identifiers, detects likely existing records, requires final confirmation, and then adds or updates records in the already-unlocked encrypted Vault. Intake values are never embedded in public source.
name: TEE v3.5.11 — Narrow Vault Intake Import
